'''Minder Twenty''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] as a [[Minder (Imperial Intelligence)|Minder]] for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="TOR" />
